[0] The latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked several upcoming Apple home products, including a new HomePod mini, a security camera, a Siri Remote designed for the next-generation Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad device.

[1] After an in-depth analysis of the code, several important clues about the HomePad specs have also emerged…

[2] Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that HomePad will most likely run a variant version of tvOS, but its operation may be closer to a giant Apple Watch.

[3] The code also reveals a rather interesting privacy feature: HomePad will only display your personal information on widgets when it detects your iPhone is nearby.

[4] We expect HomePad to launch in two versions: one equipped with a basic speaker, similar in appearance to a HomePod; the other designed for wall-mounted installation.

[5] In addition to the other Apple home products I mentioned earlier, the code also references some devices that have not yet been revealed. I sincerely hope these include a smart doorbell. Which Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
